# Allowlist for .github/scripts/check_hygiene.sh
#
# Format: one POSIX extended regular expression (grep -E) per line.
# Blank lines and lines starting with "#" are ignored.
#
# Each hit is reported as "path:line:text". A hit is dropped when that whole
# string matches any entry here, so an entry can pin a file, a line or the text.
#
# Every entry needs a reason comment on the line above it, saying why the match
# is safe to publish (for example: an invented value in a test). Keep entries
# as narrow as possible, and anchor them to a path with "^".

# Invented shared-secret value used only by the backend tests; never a real credential.
^backend/tests/test_(client_identity|edge_secret)\.py:[0-9]+:SECRET = "test-secret-value"$
